Daily Devotional

June 14

20 Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you, (1 Peter 1:20 KJV)

The Greek word “PROGINOSKO” which was translated as “foreordained” in this verse means, “to know before hand”. This is saying that Father God knew before the world was ever formed that His Son Jesus would be sent to earth to forgive the sins of the world (Revelations 13:8). Wow! Through God’s foreknowledge He already knew that He would have to sacrifice His Son for us, and still He went ahead and created the universe and us. Can you imagine how much God loves us to go ahead with His plans, even though He knew it would cost the life of Jesus to come save us? This sure shows that God is love (1 John 4:8).

How many of us would go ahead with our plans, if we knew beforehand that we would have to give our son’s life to save our creation? Not many would do that, and it sure does point out the awesome love that God has for us. If we Christians could ever lay hold of just how much God loves us (Ephesians 3:18-19), we would want to serve Him and live a holy life to glorify Him, everyday, in every way. Jesus said that if we love Him, then we should do as He has commanded (John 14:15). Thank you Father for loving us so much, and thinking we are worth the sacrifice of your Son. Glory be to God for His love.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
